---
title: "Before you arrive"
subtitle: "Do this before Monday 21 September"
---

**Before you start:** the laptop you will bring to IISc.
**When you finish:** your laptop runs R, and you have already written R code.

## The 5 steps

| | Step | Go here |
|---|---|---|
| ☐ | 1. Install R and RStudio | [Step 1](install.qmd) |
| ☐ | 2. Install the packages | [Step 2](check-setup.qmd) |
| ☐ | 3. R primers | [Step 3](primers-r.qmd) |
| ☐ | 4. Epidemiology primers | [Step 4](primers-epi.qmd) |
| ☐ | 5. Additional resources | [Step 5](../resources/index.qmd) |

Do Step 1 first. It is the one step we cannot fix for you on Monday morning.

## Short of time?

Do Steps 1 and 2. Without them you cannot do the hands-on work.

Then do Step 4. The epidemiology primers are short.

Steps 3 and 5 can wait. We re-teach the R basics in the room.

## Open the primers at home

The primers run R inside your web browser. The first page downloads about
17 MB. The heaviest page downloads about 37 MB. Your browser keeps the download
for 7 days.

**You should see:** a page you opened at home this week opens in a few seconds
at IISc.

**If it does not work:** open them before you travel. The venue wifi cannot
serve 40 people downloading 37 MB at once.

::: {.callout-note}
## Why this matters
5 days is a short time. If your laptop is not ready on Monday, you will spend
the first session watching downloads.

The primers teach the R and the arithmetic that the hands-on blocks assume you
already have.
:::

## Stuck?

1. Read [Troubleshooting](../resources/troubleshooting.qmd) first.
2. Then email [office.msicph@iisc.ac.in](mailto:office.msicph@iisc.ac.in).

Send us 3 things: your operating system and its version, the exact error
message, and the output of `sessionInfo()`.

Ask early. We answer email on working days.
